## data: bread+basket

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(arules)
library(stringr)
cafe <- read.csv('bread+basket.csv', sep=',')
cafe <- cafe[,-1]
caf_rule <- apriori(cafe, parameter = list(minlen=2,maxlen=8,support = 0.001, confidence = 0.001))

```

## top 3 popular
```{r}
head(sort(table(cafe$Item), decreasing = TRUE))

coffee <- 1:length(caf_rule)
coffee <- coffee[str_detect(caf_rule@rhs@itemInfo$labels[caf_rule@rhs@data@i+1] ,"Coffee")]

bread <- 1:length(caf_rule)
bread <- bread[str_detect(caf_rule@rhs@itemInfo$labels[caf_rule@rhs@data@i+1] ,"Bread")]

tea <- 1:length(caf_rule)
tea <- tea[str_detect(caf_rule@rhs@itemInfo$labels[caf_rule@rhs@data@i+1] ,"Tea")]

```

### Coffee
```{r}
inspect(head(sort(caf_rule[coffee], decreasing = TRUE),by = "lift",10))
inspect(head(sort(caf_rule[bread], decreasing = TRUE),by = "lift",10))
inspect(head(sort(caf_rule[tea], decreasing = TRUE),by = "lift",10))
```
coffee has most relation in afternoon on a weekday with highest Lift and Confidence
bread has most relation in morning on weekday with highest Lift and Confidence
tea has most relation in afternoon on weekday with highest Lift and Confidence

```{r}
top_3 <- c(coffee, bread, tea)
```


```{r}

cafe <- read.csv('bread+basket.csv', sep=',')
cafe_tran_item <- as.matrix(table(cafe$Transaction, cafe$Item))
cafe_tran_item <- (cafe_tran_item==1)

cafe_rules_1 <- apriori(cafe_tran_item, parameter = list(minlen=2,maxlen=2,support = 0.001, confidence = 0.001))

coffee <- 1:length(cafe_rules_1)
coffee <- coffee[str_detect(cafe_rules_1@rhs@itemInfo$labels[cafe_rules_1@rhs@data@i+1] ,"Coffee")]

bread <- 1:length(cafe_rules_1)
bread <- bread[str_detect(cafe_rules_1@rhs@itemInfo$labels[cafe_rules_1@rhs@data@i+1] ,"Bread")]

tea <- 1:length(cafe_rules_1)
tea <- tea[str_detect(cafe_rules_1@rhs@itemInfo$labels[cafe_rules_1@rhs@data@i+1] ,"Tea")]

top_3 <- c(coffee, bread, tea)


inspect(head(sort(cafe_rules_1[-top_3], decreasing = TRUE,by = "lift"),10))

```
highest relation with Lift : {Extra Salami or Feta}	=>	{Salad} and {Salad}	=>	{Extra Salami or Feta}
that's mean customer who order salad will prefer "Extra Salami or Feta" as the topping more than the other such as Soup or Spanish Brunch


```{r}
salad <- 1:length(cafe_rules_1)
salad <- salad[str_detect(cafe_rules_1@rhs@itemInfo$labels[cafe_rules_1@rhs@data@i+1] ,"Salad")]
inspect(head(sort(cafe_rules_1[salad], decreasing = TRUE,by = "lift"),10))

```
```{r}
salami <- 1:length(cafe_rules_1)
salami <- salami[str_detect(cafe_rules_1@rhs@itemInfo$labels[cafe_rules_1@rhs@data@i+1] ,"Salami")]
inspect(head(sort(cafe_rules_1[salami], decreasing = TRUE,by = "lift"),10))
```
In term of Business : To increase sales is to attach the Menu with the Image of this three combination "Salad with Extra Salami or Feta beside with coffee" for remind customer.
